footnote_text: Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of August 1, 2026, by and among Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Indivior"), Artemis Merger Sub Inc. and Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Supernus Pharmaceuticals"), at the effective time of the merger on 11/2/26, Artemis Merger Sub Inc. merged with and into Supernus Pharmaceuticals, with Supernus Pharmaceuticals surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Indivior. At the effective time, each outstanding share of Supernus Pharmaceuticals common stock was cancelled and automatically converted into the right to receive 1.5401 shares of Indivior common stock. In connection with the merger, Indivior changed its name to "Supernus, Inc." The reporting person's shares of Supernus Pharmaceuticals common stock were disposed of, and the shares of Supernus, Inc. common stock received in exchange were acquired, pursuant to the merger. The reporting person received no cash consideration other than cash in lieu of a fractional share.
